findings.frostbite_source: Frosty's on-death frostbite lands on Malik when Malik kills Frosty; Malik's art darkens
findings.hp_loss_fraction: bar length ratio 0.79-0.80 (about 20% of max HP), once per round at the turn change after the kill
findings.lost_turn: in every loss round Titan hits Malik twice before Malik kills it; in no-loss rounds once
findings.interpretation: one 50% roll: on success 20% max HP damage and the next own turn is skipped (provisional)

method: HP bar = longest red horizontal run per side; darkness = mean luminance above Malik's bar
